# Testiniai žmonės // dago

Synthetic Lithuanian person data for testing. No real-person records.
Base URL: https://dago.lt/irankiai/testiniai-zmones/

## Fetch without JavaScript
- person.v3.json: one person object, schemaVersion 3.
This is a STATIC fixture. Every request returns the same data.
Seed: dago-testiniai-zmones-v3. referenceDate: 2026-01-01.
Age is relative to referenceDate, NOT the current date.
Query parameters do not generate new people. No dynamic API exists.
Use ordinary HTTP GET. Public JSON and generator support CORS.
Legacy v1/v2 fixtures and modules remain available unchanged.
The current UI generates only one person; there is no CSV export.

## Generate fresh or reproducible data
Download src/generator.v3.mjs and import it locally in Node.js 22+,
or import its absolute HTTPS URL in a browser ES module.
The published module is self-contained; no extra files or dependencies.
Exports: generatePerson(options), avatarForPerson(person), SCHEMA_VERSION.
Options: seed (string 1..200 characters, default random UUID),
referenceDate (valid YYYY-MM-DD from 1900 to 2118, default current UTC date),
includeAvatar (boolean, default false).
For reproducible results specify both seed and referenceDate.
The same options reproduce the same v3 data. V3 preserves the base v2 identity.

## Schema 3
schemaVersion: 3; isTestData: true; referenceDate: YYYY-MM-DD;
personalCode: 11-digit Lithuanian national ID (no separate id field);
firstName, lastName, fullName, gender (vyras or moteris), birthDate (YYYY-MM-DD),
age (18..80), email, phone, address: {street, city, postalCode, country, countryCode},
occupation, company, username, password, registeredAt (YYYY-MM-DD), uuid,
nationality, website, userAgent, mothersMaidenName, heightCm, weightKg,
bloodType, favoriteColor, vehicle: {make, model, year},
location: {coordinates: {latitude, longitude, precision: city}, timezone},
payment: {provider, brand, number, expiryMonth, expiryYear, cvv},
avatar: local SVG data URL containing initials, or null.
Account creation is between the 18th birthday and referenceDate.
Passwords are deterministic testing fixtures, not production credentials.
Coordinates are approximate CITY coordinates, not house coordinates.
Source: https://www.geonames.org/LT/largest-cities-in-lithuania.html
Timezone: Europe/Vilnius. Websites use example.com subdomains.
Physical characteristics and vehicle details are fictional test values.
Payment uses Stripe's documented Visa sandbox card 4242424242424242,
future expiry and a 3-digit CVV. Only for Stripe test mode.
Source: https://docs.stripe.com/testing
Avatar generation makes no external requests and uses no real photos.
Each displayed value is a keyboard-accessible click-to-copy button.
Numeric values copy without their displayed units.

## Validation and provenance
National ID birth date, gender and checksum match the person fields.
Uses the same core as the project's asmens-kodai tool.
National IDs are generated, not sourced from individuals, but may coincide
with issued IDs and are not guaranteed globally unique.
Phone: E.164 +3706XXXXXXX, verified as valid LT mobile format with
libphonenumber-js. Does not verify assignment, activation or SMS delivery.
Do not send messages or place calls in tests.
Address: one of 7 real public-institution street/house/city/postcode pairs.
Whole pairs are selected; house numbers are never invented or changed.
Source list checked 2026-10-06:
https://github.com/debesyla/dago-irankiai/blob/main/tools/testiniai-zmones/ADDRESS-SOURCES.md
This is a limited offline list, not a national address database or live lookup.
A particular external validator may have different or outdated data.
Names may coincidentally match real people. Emails use example.com.
Company names are fictional. No claim is made that the person lives at
that real address or owns the generated number or national ID.
If you cannot fetch the URLs, disclose that instead of fabricating a fetch.

Source: https://github.com/debesyla/dago-irankiai/tree/main/tools/testiniai-zmones
